name: circady-frameworks
description_de: Single source of truth für circady Frameworks-Tab. Treibt App-Browse-Experience und Visualisierungen.
description_en: Single source of truth for circady's Frameworks tab. Drives the in-app browse experience and visualizations.

frameworks.subtitle_en: Train like an athlete — Four-pillar model

frameworks.note_de: Keine Aktivitäten — biologische Alterungsmechanismen. Im App-Frameworks-Tab als Reverse-Lookup.
frameworks.note_en: Not activities — biological aging mechanisms. Reverse-lookup in the app's Frameworks tab.

activities.description_de: Progressive Belastungssteigerung mit Hanteln, Maschinen oder Körpergewicht.
activities.description_en: Progressive overload with dumbbells, machines, or bodyweight.

activities.description_de: Hochintensives Intervalltraining zur kardiovaskulären und mitochondrialen Anpassung.
activities.description_en: High-intensity interval training for cardiovascular and mitochondrial adaptation.

activities.description_de: Mobilität, Gleichgewicht, Gelenkintegrität, Verletzungsprävention.
activities.description_en: Mobility, balance, joint integrity, injury prevention.

activities.description_de: Aerobes Training an der Laktatschwelle. Mitochondriale Effizienz.
activities.description_en: Aerobic training at lactate threshold. Mitochondrial efficiency.

activities.description_de: Bewegung durch Alltag — Gartenarbeit, Treppen, kein Auto-Reflex.
activities.description_en: Movement integrated into daily life — gardening, stairs, walking instead of driving.

activities.description_de: Niedrig-intensives, regelmäßiges Gehen.
activities.description_en: Low-intensity, regular walking.

activities.description_de: Sanfte Aktivität jenseits von Spazieren — leichtes Radeln, Schwimmen.
activities.description_en: Gentle activity beyond walking — easy cycling, swimming.

activities.description_de: Asanas, Pranayama, Mind-Body-Integration.
activities.description_en: Asanas, pranayama, mind-body integration.

activities.description_de: 150 min moderate oder 75 min intensive Bewegung pro Woche (ACLM-Leitlinie).
activities.description_en: 150 min moderate or 75 min vigorous activity per week (ACLM guideline).

activities.description_de: Tag A — Brust (Flachbank, Schrägbank, Butterfly), Schulter (Drücken, Seitheben), Trizeps, Bauch. 50–60 min, Satzpause 90s.
activities.description_en: Day A — Chest (flat/incline press, butterfly), Shoulders (press, lateral raise), Triceps, Abs. 50–60 min, 90s rest.

activities.description_de: Tag B — Beine (Beinstrecken, Beinpressen, Beincurls), Waden, Rücken (Latziehen, Rudern, Hyperextensions), Bizeps. 50–60 min.
activities.description_en: Day B — Legs (extensions, press, curls), Calves, Back (lat pull, rows, hyperextensions), Biceps. 50–60 min.

activities.description_de: Drücken: Brust, Schultern, Trizeps. Schwerpunkt auf Mehrgelenksübungen.
activities.description_en: Push: chest, shoulders, triceps. Focus on compound movements.

activities.description_de: Ziehen: Rücken, Bizeps, hintere Schulter.
activities.description_en: Pull: back, biceps, rear delts.

activities.description_de: Beintraining: Quadrizeps, Hamstrings, Glutes, Waden, Bauch.
activities.description_en: Leg day: quads, hamstrings, glutes, calves, abs.

activities.description_de: Alle großen Muskelgruppen pro Einheit. Ideal für Einsteiger oder niedrige Frequenz.
activities.description_en: All major muscle groups per session. Ideal for beginners or low frequency.

activities.description_de: Achtsamkeits- oder konzentrative Praxis.
activities.description_en: Mindfulness or concentrative practice.

activities.description_de: HRV-Training zur autonomen Balance.
activities.description_en: HRV training for autonomic balance.

activities.description_de: Therapie, emotionale Selbstkenntnis, Sinn. Attias 4. Säule.
activities.description_en: Therapy, emotional self-knowledge, purpose. Attia's 4th pillar.

activities.description_de: Aktive Stress-Downregulation — Naps, Pausen, Natur, Gebet.
activities.description_en: Active stress downregulation — naps, breaks, nature, prayer.

activities.description_de: Bewusste Atemtechniken zur Regulation.
activities.description_en: Conscious breathing techniques for regulation.

activities.description_de: Konsistenter Schlaf-Wach-Rhythmus.
activities.description_en: Consistent sleep-wake rhythm.

activities.description_de: Quantitatives Tracking via Wearable.
activities.description_en: Quantitative tracking via wearable.

activities.description_de: Dunkler, kühler Raum; kein Bildschirm; kein Alkohol oder Kaffee spätabends.
activities.description_en: Dark, cool room; no screens; no late alcohol or caffeine.

activities.description_de: 7–9 Stunden, konsistent, ungestört.
activities.description_en: 7–9 hours, consistent, undisturbed.

activities.description_de: Für Hypertrophie: mindestens 8 h, idealerweise 9 h. Wachstum passiert im Tiefschlaf.
activities.description_en: For hypertrophy: minimum 8h, ideally 9h. Growth happens in deep sleep.

activities.description_de: Sich mit Menschen umgeben, die gesunde Gewohnheiten leben.
activities.description_en: Surround yourself with people living healthy habits.

activities.description_de: Eltern, Partner, Kinder priorisieren.
activities.description_en: Prioritize parents, partner, children.

activities.description_de: Glaubensgemeinschaft oder Sinngemeinschaft.
activities.description_en: Faith community or meaning community.

activities.description_de: Gemeinschaft, langsames Essen, soziales Eingebundensein.
activities.description_en: Community, slow eating, social embeddedness.

activities.description_de: Intentionale, ausgedrückte Zuneigung.
activities.description_en: Intentional, expressed affection.

activities.description_de: Aktive Unterstützung geben und annehmen.
activities.description_en: Actively giving and receiving support.

activities.description_de: In wenige Beziehungen investieren, statt viele oberflächliche.
activities.description_en: Invest in few relationships rather than many shallow ones.

activities.description_de: Regelmäßige zwischenmenschliche Interaktion.
activities.description_en: Regular interpersonal interaction.

activities.description_de: Vollständig pflanzliche Ernährung, keine tierischen Produkte.
activities.description_en: Fully plant-based diet, no animal products.

activities.description_de: Reduktion der Energiezufuhr um 10–25 % unter Erhaltungsbedarf.
activities.description_en: 10–25% reduction in energy intake below maintenance.

activities.description_de: Eliminierung zugesetzter Zucker.
activities.description_en: Elimination of added sugars.

activities.description_de: Essen innerhalb eines 8–10 h Fensters pro Tag.
activities.description_en: Eating within an 8–10h window daily.

activities.description_de: 1.6–2.2 g pro kg Körpergewicht, verteilt über den Tag.
activities.description_en: 1.6–2.2 g per kg body weight, spread across the day.

activities.description_de: Überwiegend pflanzlich, Fleisch selten.
activities.description_en: Mostly plant-based, meat rarely.

activities.description_de: Hara hachi bu — aufhören bei 80 % Sättigung.
activities.description_en: Hara hachi bu — stop at 80% satiety.

activities.description_de: Mäßiger Rotweinkonsum mit Freunden, früh abends.
activities.description_en: Moderate red wine with friends, early evening.

activities.description_de: Mahlzeiten mit Familie oder Freunden statt allein.
activities.description_en: Meals with family or friends instead of alone.

activities.description_de: 16:8, 18:6 oder 24h-Fasten.
activities.description_en: 16:8, 18:6 or 24h fasting.

activities.description_de: Reduzierter Fleischkonsum, besonders rotes Fleisch.
activities.description_en: Reduced meat consumption, especially red meat.

activities.description_de: Pescetarisch, mediterran, niedrig im Protein bis 65, höher danach.
activities.description_en: Pescetarian, Mediterranean, lower protein until 65, higher after.

activities.description_de: Pflanzlich plus Fisch, kein Land-Tierfleisch.
activities.description_en: Plant-based plus fish, no land animal meat.

activities.description_de: 5-Tages-Protokoll mit stark reduzierter Kalorienzufuhr, 2–4× pro Jahr.
activities.description_en: 5-day protocol with strongly reduced caloric intake, 2–4× per year.

activities.description_de: Unter 10 % der Kalorien aus Fett — Ornish-Reversal-Diät.
activities.description_en: Below 10% of calories from fat — Ornish reversal diet.

activities.description_de: Vollwertig pflanzlich, minimal verarbeitet.
activities.description_en: Whole-food plant-based, minimally processed.

activities.description_de: WFPB — vollwertig, pflanzlich, minimal verarbeitet (ACLM-Leitlinie).
activities.description_en: WFPB — whole food, plant-based, minimally processed (ACLM guideline).

activities.description_de: +200 bis +500 kcal über Erhaltungsbedarf für Hypertrophie.
activities.description_en: +200 to +500 kcal above maintenance for hypertrophy.

activities.description_de: Umfangreiches Supplement-Protokoll (Bryan Johnsons Protokoll).
activities.description_en: Comprehensive supplement protocol (Bryan Johnson's protocol).

activities.description_de: NMN oder NR zur NAD+-Erhöhung.
activities.description_en: NMN or NR for NAD+ elevation.

activities.description_de: Nicotinamid-Mononukleotid — NAD+-Vorläufer.
activities.description_en: Nicotinamide mononucleotide — NAD+ precursor.

activities.description_de: Sirtuin-Aktivator, mit fettreicher Mahlzeit.
activities.description_en: Sirtuin activator, taken with high-fat meal.

activities.description_de: Kein Tabak, minimal Alkohol, keine schädlichen Drogen.
activities.description_en: No tobacco, minimal alcohol, no harmful drugs.

activities.description_de: 3–5 g pro Tag, Kreatinmonohydrat. Sicheres Hypertrophie-Supplement.
activities.description_en: 3–5 g daily, creatine monohydrate. Safe hypertrophy supplement.
